title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 4th Proof The Consensus Of The Prophets

questions.question: According to the passage, how does the agreement of the prophets serve as evidence about this being?
questions.answer: It supports both Allah’s oneness and the truth that this being is a real messenger.

questions.question: What reason is given for linking the earlier prophets to the truthfulness of this messenger?
questions.answer: The qualities, signs, and duties that prove prophethood were found in him completely, as history shows.

questions.question: In which earlier revealed books are announcements of his coming said to appear?
questions.answer: In the Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: Besides spoken predictions, what else from the prophets is said to confirm his mission?
questions.answer: Their prophetic works and miracles also support and approve his mission.

questions.question: What is meant by saying the prophets “signed” his mission through their deeds?
questions.answer: Their actions served like a strong confirmation that his mission is genuine.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from the prophets’ shared witness?
questions.answer: He understood that their united testimony points clearly to this being’s truthfulness.

questions.question: Who are the people mentioned in the fifth section after the prophets?
questions.answer: They are the many saints who reached truth, spiritual realization, and perfection by following his teaching.

questions.question: What two major truths do these saints agree on?
questions.answer: They agree on Allah’s oneness and on the truthfulness and messengerhood of this being.

questions.question: How did these saints gain access to some of the unseen truths he taught?
questions.answer: They perceived some of them through the light of sainthood.

questions.question: How did they respond to all the truths he brought, even beyond what they directly witnessed?
questions.answer: They believed in and confirmed all of them with different levels of certainty.

questions.question: What does the passage say this saintly witness shows about their master?
questions.answer: It shows very clearly that he was completely truthful and upright.

questions.question: What kind of proof is the prophets’ united agreement described as in the passage?
questions.answer: It is described as a strong and firm proof.

questions.question: The passage says the earlier prophets testified to this being in two main ways. What are they?
questions.answer: They testified through their words and through their actions and miracles.

questions.question: What do the earlier scriptures contribute to the case for this messenger?
questions.answer: They contain glad tidings and predictions about his coming.

questions.question: Why is his mission presented as standing at the highest level among prophetic missions?
questions.answer: Because he is described as the foremost and most complete in carrying out the work of prophethood.

questions.question: How does the passage connect belief in Allah’s unity with belief in this messenger’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: The same prophets who agree on Allah’s oneness also agree in confirming his truthfulness.

questions.question: What effect did this prophetic testimony have on the traveler?
questions.answer: It led him to recognize and accept the truth of this being’s mission.

questions.question: According to the fifth section, what did the saints achieve by following this being?
questions.answer: They reached truth, reality, perfection, extraordinary deeds, unveiling, and witnessing.

questions.question: Why is the witness of these saints especially important in the passage’s argument?
questions.answer: Because their spiritual growth came through his guidance, so their success supports the truth of his path.

questions.question: What part of his message did the saints directly experience in some measure?
questions.answer: They experienced some of the unseen truths he had taught.

questions.question: What three levels of certainty are mentioned for their affirmation of his teachings?
questions.answer: Knowledge of certainty, vision of certainty, and absolute certainty.

questions.question: What comparison is used to describe how clearly the saints’ witness proves his truthfulness?
questions.answer: It is compared to the clarity of the sun.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the fourth section?
questions.answer: The witness of the prophets to the truthfulness and messengerhood of this being.

questions.question: According to the passage, what did history testify about him in relation to earlier prophets?
questions.answer: History testified that the signs and qualities proving prophethood were fully present in him.

questions.question: What do the earlier prophets announce about him in their revealed books?
questions.answer: They announce his coming and give glad news about him.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that many examples from scripture were already proven elsewhere?
questions.answer: To show that the claim of earlier predictions is supported by detailed evidence.

questions.question: How do the prophets’ miracles function in relation to his mission?
questions.answer: They act as a confirmation of his mission along with their spoken predictions.

questions.question: What does the phrase about their “unanimity of deeds” point to?
questions.answer: It points to their shared practical confirmation of his truthfulness.

questions.question: In the fifth section, who are said to follow this being and then testify to him?
questions.answer: Thousands of saints who attained high spiritual states through his instruction.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the source of the saints’ spiritual accomplishments?
questions.answer: Their accomplishments came through learning from him and following his way.

questions.question: Do the saints testify only to Allah’s unity? Explain.
questions.answer: No. They testify both to Allah’s unity and to this being’s truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: How is the saints’ confirmation of unseen truths different from simple blind acceptance?
questions.answer: It is based on spiritual insight and levels of certainty, not mere unsupported belief.

questions.question: What does the traveler conclude from the witness of the saints?
questions.answer: He concludes that their master’s honesty and straightness are overwhelmingly clear.

questions.question: What common method of proof is used in both sections?
questions.answer: Both use the united agreement of trustworthy groups as evidence.

questions.question: Why is the consensus of the prophets described as powerful evidence?
questions.answer: Because many true messengers agree in affirming this being’s truthfulness and mission.

questions.question: What features found in all prophets are said to be present fully in this being?
questions.answer: The sacred qualities, miracles, and prophetic duties that show a person is truly sent by Allah.

questions.question: Which revealed writings are named as containing good news about him?
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed pages.

questions.question: What image does the passage use to show how the prophets support his mission through their deeds?
questions.answer: It presents their deeds as if they placed their approval on his mission.

questions.question: What did the traveler learn from the prophets’ agreement in word and deed?
questions.answer: He learned that their united testimony confirms this being’s truthfulness.

questions.question: In the fifth section, what kinds of people are introduced as another body of witnesses?
questions.answer: Spiritually accomplished saints who reached high levels through his teaching.

questions.question: What are some of the things these saints are said to have attained?
questions.answer: Truth, reality, perfection, extraordinary spiritual acts, unveiling, and witnessing.

questions.question: How does their spiritual experience relate to the unseen matters he taught?
questions.answer: They came to witness some of those matters through spiritual light.

questions.question: How do they treat the rest of the unseen truths he proclaimed?
questions.answer: They affirm all of them through faith with strong degrees of certainty.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about the reliability of the saints’ testimony?
questions.answer: It implies that their testimony is highly reliable because it is united and based on real spiritual attainment.

questions.question: What description is given of the clarity of this proof?
questions.answer: It is described as being as plain and bright as the sun.

questions.question: What two truths are supported by the prophets’ agreement according to the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s unity and the truthfulness of this messenger.

questions.question: What basis does the passage give for saying the prophets support him?
questions.answer: It says the marks of true prophethood were present in him fully.

questions.question: What role do earlier scriptures play in this section?
questions.answer: They are presented as containing advance announcements of his arrival.

questions.question: How many examples of these scriptural announcements are said to have been set out elsewhere?
questions.answer: More than twenty strong examples.

questions.question: What other kind of prophetic evidence is mentioned besides words in scripture?
questions.answer: The prophets’ actions and miracles.

questions.question: Why does the passage stress that he is foremost and most complete in prophetic work?
questions.answer: To show that his mission is not merely similar to others but stands at the highest level.

questions.question: Who are the unanimous witnesses mentioned in the next section?
questions.answer: Thousands of saints formed by his instruction and example.

questions.question: What does their following of him add to the argument?
questions.answer: It shows that his guidance actually produces real spiritual knowledge and growth.

questions.question: What part of his message did they confirm through direct spiritual light?
questions.answer: Some of the realities concerning the unseen world.

questions.question: What does the phrase comparing this proof to the sun suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that the proof is bright, obvious, and hard to deny.

questions.question: According to the fourth section, what makes the prophets’ shared testimony especially weighty?
questions.answer: They are all true messengers, so their united agreement carries great authority.

questions.question: What does the passage say existed in this being just as in the other prophets?
questions.answer: The qualities, miracles, and roles that indicate true prophethood.

questions.question: What are the named sources in which earlier prophets gave news of his coming?
questions.answer: The Torah, the Gospels, the Psalms, and other revealed writings.

questions.question: How do the prophets’ miracles relate to their witness for him?
questions.answer: Their miracles, connected to their own missions, also serve as a practical confirmation of his mission.

questions.question: What is the difference between the prophets’ verbal witness and their witness by deeds?
questions.answer: One comes through spoken or written announcements, and the other through their prophetic actions and miracles.

questions.question: What understanding did the traveler reach after considering the prophets’ agreement?
questions.answer: He recognized that their united witness confirms this being’s truthfulness.

questions.question: In the fifth section, what group is presented as the next testimony after the prophets?
questions.answer: Saints who reached spiritual perfection by learning from and following him.

questions.question: What does the passage say these saints testify to besides Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: They also testify to his truthfulness and messengerhood.

questions.question: How did the saints come to know some of the unseen truths he taught?
questions.answer: They came to know them through the light of sainthood.

questions.question: What does it mean that they affirmed all his teachings with varying levels of certainty?
questions.answer: It means their belief was deeply grounded, ranging from sure knowledge to direct and complete certainty.

questions.question: What conclusion about their master is drawn from their witness?
questions.answer: That he possessed a very high degree of truthfulness and moral straightness.
